name: The St Regis Mardavall Mallorca Resort
positioning: Sea-facing St. Regis resort in Costa d'en Blanes, Palma de Mallorca, spread over four terracotta-toned buildings, with the Michelin-starred Es Fum
best_for: Food lovers who want a Michelin-starred restaurant on site

facts.text: The resort is on the Carretera Palma-Andratx in Costa d'en Blanes, Palma de Mallorca.
The resort is spread over four terracotta-toned buildings.
Each room and suite has a private terrace or balcony, overlooking the Mediterranean Sea or the resort's gardens.
St. Regis Butler service is provided in all room types.
The spa blends Eastern and Western therapies and includes Egyptian brine baths and an ice cave.
Terra serves island flavors under the theme 'Recipes and products of Mallorca'.
The resort's own take on the St. Regis Bloody Mary is the Mardavall Snapper, infused with island flavors.
The Explorers Club offers daily programming for children; children who complete its tasks receive an Explorer's Certificate.
Dogs and cats up to 11 kg are welcome.
Through a collaboration with Gallery Red, the resort shows contemporary art, and a share of sales goes to the Mallorca Preservation Foundation.

highlights.text: Es Fum is a Michelin-starred restaurant with a Sol Repsol, where chef Miguel Navarro cooks facing the Mediterranean.
Some residences, such as the St. Regis Pool Residence, have a private pool at garden level.
Mar Sea Club has a beachfront location and sea views, serving Mediterranean and Latin American flavors.
Sabrage, opening champagne with a saber, is the signature ceremony of the St. Regis Evening Rituals, offered as a sunset celebration at the resort.
The resort offers an excursion that flies over Mallorca to Menorca, then continues by private yacht to Isla del Rey.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide a shuttle service.
Parents must remain on resort premises while their children attend the Explorers Club.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the resort's exclusive positioning.
